checks: missing key or durable limiter is explicit and makes no upstream request
bounded administrative inputs reject duplicate and unrelated data; canonical city IDs own labels
exact-origin CORS rejects impostor/null origins before quota and never permits credentials
fixed provider requests transmit only administrative query and server key; no patient auth or health payload
city identity and administrative prefixes are checked; wrong, missing or ambiguous settlements cannot default
primary list excludes unnamed, specialty, dental, maternity, addiction and non-care listings without claiming suitability
radius bounds, numeric coordinates, deduplication and six-card cap are independently enforced
20km expansion is at most one call, only after zero eligible 10km results, without unbounded pagination
upstream errors, raw URLs and key echoes never escape; public fields remain bounded
response size and latency bounds cover announced bytes, streaming and ignored abort signals
atomic quota ordering caps concurrent callers and prevents denied IPs from exhausting shared budget
Cloudflare route and isolated Worker read only geographic bindings and reject patient endpoints
limitations: Synthetic Geoapify responses and ephemeral Miniflare D1 only. This report does not validate live coverage, clinical suitability, emergency capacity, opening hours, public gateway hosting, or publication. Category-based records remain explicitly unverified. Separate real provider checks/snapshots require separate dated evidence.
